title: A Study of Efficacy and Safety of GenSci048 in Subjects With Active Uveitis.
off: A Phase II Clinical Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of GenSci048 in Subjects With Active Non-infectious Uveitis.
summary: This study is designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of GenSci048 compared with placebo in subjects with active non-infectious uveitis.

arms.d: GenSci048 high-dose administered subcutaneously (SC) according to the protocol.

primary.m: The effectiveness of GenSci048 administered by subcutaneous injection
